question: For plants that start up from 2026, how small must a renewable plant be to still get first call when the grid operator decides which plants run?
reply: {"gold_answers": "yes", "gold_reason": "Article 12(5) of Regulation 2019/943 states that for power-generating facilities commissioned from 1 January 2026, the priority dispatch point in 12(2)(a) applies only to renewable facilities under 200 kW; 12(2)(a) gives the 400 kW threshold otherwise.", "other_articles": [], "ambiguity": "minor", "ambiguity_reason": "The question uses lay terms ('first call', 'start up') but clearly maps to priority dispatch and commissioning from 1 January 2026. Demonstration projects are a separate route and do not change the size threshold.", "suggested_fix": ""}

verdict.gold_reason: Article 12(5) of Regulation 2019/943 states that for power-generating facilities commissioned from 1 January 2026, the priority dispatch point in 12(2)(a) applies only to renewable facilities under 200 kW; 12(2)(a) gives the 400 kW threshold otherwise.
verdict.ambiguity_reason: The question uses lay terms ('first call', 'start up') but clearly maps to priority dispatch and commissioning from 1 January 2026. Demonstration projects are a separate route and do not change the size threshold.
